title: Monastery of the Holy Spirit
scope: The standing poured-concrete Abbey Church and connected main monastic ranges of the Monastery of the Holy Spirit in Conyers, Georgia.
limitations: Heights, glazing detail and short roof projections are approximate. The church and adjoining monastery outlines come from the named OpenStreetMap building geometry.
The model covers the standing church and joined core cloister. The removed original monastery and distant visitor facilities fall outside its scope.
